We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.

## Health Systems Worldwide

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.

care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Fast. Simple. Convenient. Book your next appointment online.

[Schedule now][26]
[Notice of Xsolis data incident.][27]
[Notice of DentaQuest data incident.][28] 
What Banner Offers

From treating minor injuries to delivering a baby, Banner Health is here to support you and your
family with safe, high-quality care. With options like telehealth services and virtual tools for
in-person visits, we make it easy to access the care you need. [Learn more about all the services we
provide][29].

### Urgent Care


Convenient care for non-emergency needs. Schedule online or walk in and start feeling better. [Learn
more.][30]

### Imaging


Advanced technology and expert teams deliver precise diagnostics and exceptional care. [Learn
more.][31]

### Surgery Centers


A lower-cost, convenient alternative to inpatient procedures with a smooth, at-home recovery. [Learn
more. ][32]

### Maternity


Guiding you through pregnancy with comfort, knowledge and expert care. [Learn more.][33]

### Hospice


Compassionate end-of-life care and support for you and your loved ones. [Learn more.][34]

### Home Care


Safe, comfortable recovery at home after illness or injury. [Learn more.][35]

### Telehealth


Quality care, wherever you are. Connect with providers from home. [Learn more.][36]

### Emergency


24/7 expert care, close to home. Stay connected during your visit with our Chatbot. [Learn
more.][37]

## Save time by diagnosing your symptoms online.

Up in the middle of the night with a sick child? Wondering if that cold or lingering cough is
something more serious? Being sick or trying to care for a sick loved one can be stressful but
finding the right care or treatment shouldn’t be. Our symptom checker can help you find the right
care.

[Start Now][38]
Banner Orthopedics & Sports Medicine: Caring for Professional and Collegiate Athletes

Our world-class doctors, caregivers and facilities provide athletes with the support they need to
excel. Whether designing health and wellness programs to prepare athletes for the demands of a
season or helping them recover from injuries, the Banner Orthopedics & Sports Medicine team delivers
unmatched care and support.

[Learn More][39]

## WebMD® Choice Awards recognition

Banner Health has been recognized as the most preferred health system in Arizona by the WebMD®
Choice Awards for the second consecutive year. Learn about this prestigious award and Banner
Health's commitment to providing exceptional patient care. 
[Learn More][40]

## **Find a Doctor Near You**

****
All your health information in one place.

With your Banner Health account you can:
* View lab results
* Request medical records
* Schedule appointments
* Message a doctor's office
* Access important documents

[Learn More][41]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Welcome

Welcome to the official *Food Allergies For Dummies* website. We created this site to give people a
place where they could sample the contents of the book and find out more about its authors. Here,
you will find a brief description of the book, the complete table of contents, a sample chapter (on
working with your doctor to arrive at an accurate diagnosis), information about us, a convenient
online glossary of common food allergy related terms, a collection of articles, and contact
information, so you can get in touch with us.

Although we created this website *primarily* to promote *Food Allergies For Dummies*, we also offer
some additional content, which you can find below **Articles** in the navigation bar on the left.
Some of the articles that appear here are pieces that we wrote for other publications, including
food allergy newsletters. We may add articles in the future.

We hope you enjoy the website and love the book!

> **Disclaimer: **The information we provide on this site is no substitute for medical treatment. If
> you suspect that you or a loved one suffers from food allergies or some other illness, seek
> professional medical advice sooner rather than later. We want you and your family to be as healthy
> and happy as you deserve to be.

# Welcome

Welcome to the official *Food Allergies For Dummies* website. We created this site to give people a
place where they could sample the contents of the book and find out more about its authors. Here,
you will find a brief description of the book, the complete table of contents, a sample chapter (on
working with your doctor to arrive at an accurate diagnosis), information about us, a convenient
online glossary of common food allergy related terms, a collection of articles, and contact
information, so you can get in touch with us.

Although we created this website *primarily* to promote *Food Allergies For Dummies*, we also offer
some additional content, which you can find below **Articles** in the navigation bar on the left.
Some of the articles that appear here are pieces that we wrote for other publications, including
food allergy newsletters. We may add articles in the future.

We hope you enjoy the website and love the book!

> **Disclaimer: **The information we provide on this site is no substitute for medical treatment. If
> you suspect that you or a loved one suffers from food allergies or some other illness, seek
> professional medical advice sooner rather than later. We want you and your family to be as healthy
> and happy as you deserve to be.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

Expand

The following information applies to both EPIPEN and its Authorized Generic

EPIPEN^{®} (epinephrine injection, USP) 0.3 mg and EPIPEN JR^{®} (epinephrine injection, USP) 0.15
mg Auto-Injectors are used to treat allergic emergencies (anaphylaxis). Anaphylaxis can be life
threatening and happen within minutes. If untreated, anaphylaxis can cause death. This allergic
emergency can be caused by stinging and biting insects, allergy injections, foods, medicines,
exercise, or unknown causes.

**Always carry 2 EPIPEN or 2 EPIPEN JR Auto-Injectors** with you because sometimes a single dose of
epinephrine may not be enough to treat a serious allergic reaction before seeking medical care.

**When you have an allergic emergency (anaphylaxis), use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors right
away**. Get emergency medical help right away even if you have used the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR
auto-injector. You can use a second EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector if symptoms continue or if the
first auto-injector is activated. If you need more than 2 doses for an allergic emergency, they must
be given by a healthcare provider.

**Before you use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors, tell your healthcare provider about all your
medical conditions.** Your healthcare provider may give you more instructions about when and how to
use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR if you have heart problems or high blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid
problems, asthma, a history of depression, Parkinson’s disease, are pregnant or plan to become
pregnant, are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.

Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and herbal supplements. Tell your healthcare provider about all
of your known allergies. If you have certain medical conditions, or take certain medicines, your
condition may get worse, or you may have longer lasting side effects when you use your EPIPEN or
EPIPEN JR auto-injector.

**Especially tell your healthcare provider if you take certain asthma medicines.** EPIPEN and EPIPEN
JR and other medicines may affect the way other medicines work. Other medicines may affect how
EPIPEN and EPIPEN JR auto-injector works.

EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector should be injected into the middle of your outer thigh (upper
leg), through clothing if necessary. **Do not** inject into your veins, buttocks, fingers, toes,
hands or feet. **It is very important that you hold the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector down
firmly on the middle of the outer thigh (upper leg) for at least 3 full seconds. If you do not hold
it in place long enough, the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector might not have time to deliver the
correct dose of medicine. ** If you accidentally inject EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors into any
place other than the middle of your outer thigh, go to the nearest emergency room right away. If you
inject a young child, hold their leg firmly in place before and during the 3 second injection to
prevent injuries.

Rarely, patients who have used EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors may get infections at the
injection site within a few days. Some of these infections can be serious. Call your healthcare
professional right away if you have any of the following at an injection site: redness that does not
go away, swelling, tenderness, or the area feels warm to the touch.

if you have any side effect that bothers you or that does not go away.

Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at
[1-800-FDA-1088.][21]

### INDICATIONS

The following information applies to both EPIPEN and its Authorized Generic

EPIPEN^{®} and EPIPEN JR^{®} Auto-Injectors are used to treat life-threatening, allergic emergencies
in people who are at risk for or have a history of serious allergic emergencies. EPIPEN and EPIPEN
JR are for immediate administration by you or your caregiver. They do not take the place of
emergency medical care. You should get emergency help right away after using your EPIPEN or EPIPEN
JR.

**Please see the full [Prescribing Information][22] and [Patient Information][23] for EPIPEN.**
**Please see the full [Prescribing Information][24] and [Patient Information][25] for the Authorized
Generic for EPIPEN.**

The EPIPEN Auto-Injectors are available by Rx only.

Patients should always ask their doctors for medical advice about adverse events.

You are encouraged to report adverse events related to Viatris products by calling
[1-877-446-3679][26] (US only). If you prefer, you may contact the US Food and Drug Administration
(FDA) directly. Visit [http://www.fda.gov/MedWatch][27] or call [1-800-FDA-1088][28].

This site is intended only for US residents. The products discussed in this site may have different
product labeling in different countries. The information provided is for educational purposes only
and is not intended to replace discussions with a healthcare provider.

# Gateway FEAST: Food Allergy, Eczema, and Asthma Support Team

[Support group for allergies]

## Welcome to Gateway FEAST

Gateway FEAST is a support group and educational resource for people who manage food allergies,
eczema, and asthma, serving the St. Louis area community in Missouri and Illinois. We offer support
and education to members through our **[Facebook group][20]** and member events, promote community
awareness about allergic conditions through our outreach programs, and work in concert with other
St. Louis area organizations to host community events for children with life-threatening food
allergies and their families.

Gateway FEAST is an all-volunteer organization, founded and run by families that live with allergic
conditions, and recommended by local allergists and by national allergy and asthma organizations
including [Food Allergy Research and Education][21] (FARE) and the [Allergy and Asthma Foundation of
America][22] (AAFA).

What do the letters in FEAST stand for?

**F**ood Allergy
**E**czema
**A**sthma, Seasonal **A**llergy, and Environmental **A**llergy
**S**upport
**T**eam

[Events for kids with food allergies]

## Events for children with food allergies and their families

Gateway FEAST works with multiple St. Louis area organizations to offer allergy-friendly events that
make children with food allergies and their families feel welcome and included.

Learn more about Gateway FEAST events on our [Events page][23].

# Gateway FEAST: Food Allergy, Eczema, and Asthma Support Team

[Support group for allergies]

## Welcome to Gateway FEAST

Gateway FEAST is a support group and educational resource for people who manage food allergies,
eczema, and asthma, serving the St. Louis area community in Missouri and Illinois. We offer support
and education to members through our **[Facebook group][20]** and member events, promote community
awareness about allergic conditions through our outreach programs, and work in concert with other
St. Louis area organizations to host community events for children with life-threatening food
allergies and their families.

Gateway FEAST is an all-volunteer organization, founded and run by families that live with allergic
conditions, and recommended by local allergists and by national allergy and asthma organizations
including [Food Allergy Research and Education][21] (FARE) and the [Allergy and Asthma Foundation of
America][22] (AAFA).

What do the letters in FEAST stand for?

**F**ood Allergy
**E**czema
**A**sthma, Seasonal **A**llergy, and Environmental **A**llergy
**S**upport
**T**eam

[Events for kids with food allergies]

## Events for children with food allergies and their families

Gateway FEAST works with multiple St. Louis area organizations to offer allergy-friendly events that
make children with food allergies and their families feel welcome and included.

Learn more about Gateway FEAST events on our [Events page][23].

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

operate as intended in the given enterprise environment.

and verification, testing for regulatory approval, global product launch, and field deployment.

#### Regulatory Specialists

Integra Systems has an established understanding of the wireless regulatory process for medical
devices. This expertise has included authorship of test protocols and testing for FDA 510(k)
submittal.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.

development using GeoGebra through a lesson study approach][11]
(2026) Ssennyomo, Bernard John; Erwin, David; Mhakure, Duncan
Show more
The study aimed to investigate the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) development
of rural high school mathematics teachers when using GeoGebra and a school-based lesson study (LS)
continuous professional development (CPD) approach to teach transformation geometry. The research
objectives that guided this study's aim were to: Establish the extent of the use of GeoGebra and the
LS as a school-based CPD approach in mathematics teaching in high schools in the JTG district prior
to the main study. Investigate the level of TPACK developed when rural high school mathematics
teachers use GeoGebra to teach transformation geometry during a school-based LS CPD approach.
Investigate the experiences of rural high school mathematics teachers when teaching transformation
geometry using GeoGebra. The primary research question underlying this study is: What is the TPACK
development of mathematics teachers from rural high schools when using GeoGebra and the LS approach
as a form of school-based CPD to teach transformation geometry? The study employed a mixed methods
complementarity design, blending quantitative and qualitative approaches, guided primarily by an
interpretive paradigm, while acknowledging pragmatic considerations. A total of 135 mathematics
teachers from the 31 high schools in the Northern Cape Province's JTG district completed a baseline
survey. The baseline survey focused on the extent of technology use (in particular, GeoGebra) in
teaching mathematics and the nature of CPDs – a school-based LS CPD approach, in this case to which
teachers in the JTG district were exposed. Following the baseline survey, six teachers from two
specific schools (A and B) were selected purposively from the 31 high schools in the district for
further study. These teachers taught Senior and Further Education and Training (FET) Phase
mathematics at two rural high schools selected for research. Each of the two schools formed a LS
group of three teachers. These schools' selection criteria included inter alia that they were
located in low socio-economic areas, and that neither had a computer laboratory, although the
teachers had laptops and mobile projectors. The Theory of Didactical Situations (TDS) was used to
foreground this study. The data were collected from multiple sources, including a baseline survey,
focus group interviews (FGIs) conducted after the teacher training session on GeoGebra and the LS
with the six teachers and the three transformation geometry research lessons (RLs), and observation
guides. The three transformation geometry RLs focused on the concepts of reflection about the x- and
y-axis, reflection about the line y = x, and translation. The baseline survey findings showed
limited usage of GeoGebra and the LS in mathematics teaching within the JTG district's high schools.

resources and training, among others, were noted to be preventing the teachers from integrating the
software into their lessons. Additionally, factors including inter alia lack of support from school

## Connect with the right manufacturers

# Connect with the right manufacturers

Reduce time-to-contract by finding qualified manufacturers. Share your business case and connect
with suppliers directly.
* Get vetted information on products and manufacturers
* Make requests for quotations easily
* Connect with manufacturers directly
* Close best-price deals without any brokerage fees

Go to the marketplace

# How it works:

# from product discovery to closed deal

We assist you in discovering new products, matching with potential qualified manufacturers, and
making the deals happen.
1. 1. Discover new products Search for the high-potential products in the largest expert-curated CTD
   database. Narrow your search applying the industry-specific filter that helps sort products by
   GMP approvals, country of origin, dossier type, dossier status, and other valuable features.
2. 2. Get positive response from manufacturers Submit a request indicating your target market(s),
   annual purchase forecast, preferable deal type, and your specific remarks. Get feedback via
   email. Use our platform to track your inquiry progress.
3. 3. Connect with qualified manufacturers directly Upon a supplier confirming interest, we
   facilitate direct negotiations between you and the supplier, empowering you with control and
   transparency throughout the process. Importantly, there are no additional fees, and you finalise
   all deals directly with the suppliers.

## Everything you need to pitch with confidence

From deck feedback to financial research, PitchGrade gives founders and analysts the tools to make
smarter decisions.

### AI Deck Review

Get a detailed score, structured feedback, and actionable suggestions on every slide of your pitch
deck.

### Investor Matching

See how your deck fits with 20+ top investors like Sequoia, a16z, and YC — or enter your own target
investor.

### Research AgentNew

An autonomous agent that builds DCF models, pulls SEC filings, runs peer comps, and writes
investment theses — without you lifting a finger.

[Try it free →][2]

### Slide Generator

Generate styled, investor-ready PPTX slide decks from a prompt — powered by AI and ready to
download.

### Live Financial Data

Real-time stock quotes, income statements, analyst consensus, and insider activity for thousands of
companies.

### Company Comparison

Compare up to 4 companies side by side on market cap, revenue, margins, P/E ratio, and more.

1

### Upload your deck

### Get scored feedback

### Rewrite and improve

### **We're dedicated to advancing the field of anaphylaxis treatment and providing cutting-edge
### medical treatment options for severe allergic reactions.**

### Our portfolio includes innovative anaphylaxis medication and drugs specifically designed to meet
### the urgent needs of patients and healthcare providers. Through rigorous research and
### development, we have introduced solutions that aim to improve outcomes and save lives in
### critical situations.

### **For use by licensed health care professionals authorized to administer prescription
### medication. Available nationwide at your wholesaler or distributor.**

## Epinephrine Snap-V kit

$125.00

**Designed to treat anaphylaxis in patients weighing equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33
lbs.** Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™.  Epinephrine Snap-V kits contain (1) vial of
epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up to 3 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and
additional patents pending.

[More info >][39]

[ [comp_ESnapV-min[1]] ][40]

## Epinephrine Snap-EMS kit

$120.00

**Specifically designed to meet the protocols of the Emergency Medical market.** For use in patients
equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33 lbs. Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™. 
Epinephrine Snap-EMS kits contain (1) vial of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up
to 2 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and additional patents pending.

[More info >][41]

[ [comp_ESnapEMS-min[1]] ][42]

## Epinephrine Snap kit

$120.00

**Can be utilized for adult, teen, and pediatric patients. **Epinephrine Snap kits contain (1) vial
of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL, and (3) 1 mL Non-Residue Gasket For Minimal Dead Space Syringes for more
precise dosing.

[More info >][43]

[ [comp_ESnap-min[1]] ][44]

## The Epinephrine Syringe

$268.00 (Box of 100)

**Our proprietary syringe** allows for easier dosing in anaphylactic emergencies. The Epinephrine
Syringes have visual markings for commonly utilized doses when treating anaphylaxis in patients
weighing 15 kg or 33 lbs*.

###### *See our resources page for anaphylaxis protocols

[More info >][45]

[ [The Epinephrine Syringe] ][46]

## Snap Med Pack

$15.00

**Designed for those creating their own medical kits**. The Pak comes empty and features a pocket
and elastic band to keep your customized selection of supplies in place.

[More info >][47]

[ [snapmedpak-min[1]] ][48]

Understanding the importance of immediate response, our products are engineered for ease of use and
effectiveness. From our Epinephrine Syringe™ injector to our comprehensive anaphylaxis kits, we
offer a range of options to ensure that medical professionals are prepared to act swiftly and
effectively. Our commitment to quality and patient safety drives our mission to develop the most
reliable and accessible epinephrine and anaphylaxis solutions on the market.

Snap Medical Industries stands at the forefront of anaphylaxis treatment innovation. By focusing on
the development of essential treatments for anaphylaxis, we aim to bridge the gap between medical
needs and available treatment options. Our goal is to empower the medical and dental community with
the tools and knowledge necessary for effective anaphylaxis management, making a significant impact
on healthcare outcomes worldwide.

## We serve the Medical, Dental, and EMS markets.

Snap Medical Industries spent two years researching and vetting ideas for our epinephrine products
based on clinical experience and the use of epinephrine in anaphylaxis. Our kits are a low-cost
alternative to epinephrine auto injectors.

We are a licensed manufacturer of epinephrine convenience kits with the Boards of Pharmacy
nationwide. Our products are registered with the FDA and we retain FDA experts to assure that our
kits are manufactured under the highest standards [Skip to content][1]
